system.description: You bolster the resolve of an injured ally. As a bonus action, select one allied creature within 30 feet of you that has taken damage within the last minute. When you do, you spend one Superiority Die to inspire them. They can spend one Hit die. They regain hit points equal to your Superiority Die plus their Hit die.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.

activities.label: Defensive Rally
activities.text: Bonus action: an ally within 30 feet damaged in the last minute regains the die plus a Hit Die it spends (it rolls the Hit Die).
